\section{Detailed Results}
\label{app:detailed}

We run two language-model backends, GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet, three runs each: the approach is
stochastic, while the baselines are deterministic. The body reports GPT-5.4 and the five-project,
three-run average. For space, this appendix collects the per-project and per-run breakdowns and the
Claude Sonnet results. The structure and macros match the body floats, so each table reads the same way.

and the size-aware metrics---for all four systems on both backends, per project, with a five-project
average row per system. \autoref{tab:detailed-perrun} gives the same suite per run for \approach{}
on both backends, with the run average, so the run-to-run spread behind the body numbers
(\autoref{tab:rq1}, \autoref{tab:rq2}) is visible.
